regime_context: The detector shows a clear defensive/healthcare concentration: Big Pharma is the headline theme (highest trend-gate durability, full breadth, crowded), with Healthcare EW, Defensives, and Consumer Staples also eligible, high-durability, and crowded. Rotation breadth is narrowing (39% eligible) with weak absorption (0.32) and no one-narrative structure; the split among pharma, staples, and energy shows a risk-off, flock-to-defensives texture rather than a single dominant story. Track record shows only 41% directional accuracy across 138 calls, so conviction is capped low throughout.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the defensives cluster (Big Pharma + Healthcare EW + Staples) stays coherent and eligible. If Big Pharma's breadth falls below ~0.7 or its durability_bar drops below 0.6 while the benchmark keeps trending, the defensive leadership story is fraying and I would retire the cluster read.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme with the strongest trend-gate profile: eligible, durability_bar 0.84, hurst 'trend', breadth 1.0, and score confirming. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg and it is currently on for this theme. Crowding (z=1.46) is a size-down caution, not a fade signal under the guardrails.
theses.dissent: Crowded defensive trade with full breadth can reverse sharply when the macro risk-off regime eases; the detector's momentum rank has no forward return edge, and the next narrative could rotate away from healthcare without warning.

falsifier.text: PPH trails the S&P 500 by more than 5% over any 30-day stretch before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Confirms the defensive-health leadership via the broad sector lens rather than just headline pharma: eligible, durability 0.78, trend, breadth 0.917. This offers a less single-stock-concentrated way to express the same trend-gate-supported defensive tilt.
evidence: rotation view 'narrowing' with defensives cluster eligible
theses.dissent: Both healthcare themes are crowded (z 1.46 and 1.54); a broad risk-on reversal would hit the whole defensive cluster at once, with no momentum edge to cushion it.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks below its own 200-day moving average while the S&P 500 holds above its own

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Second leg of the defensive cluster: eligible, durability 0.80, trend, breadth 0.879. The most crowded theme in the set (z=1.89), which the guardrails treat strictly as a size-down caution — the trend gate still supports direction, but a low-conviction lean given crowding and the weak prior directional record.
theses.dissent: Most crowded theme in the set — reflexive unwinds in crowded defensive staples can be sharp; rank-IC ~0 means the high momentum rank is not a return signal.

falsifier.text: XLP loses its trend-gate eligibility (durability_bar drops below its moving-average threshold) before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
